safety_overall: The safety landscape is critically compromised by severe physical feasibility failures that manifest as immediate safety hazards. Both candidates exhibit calculated pressure drops (1154 bar and 3647 bar) that vastly exceed the pump maximum (20 bar) and the BPR setting (3 bar). While the chemical hazards (DMF, Pd catalyst) are manageable with standard PPE and closed systems, the mechanical integrity of the proposed flow setup is non-existent. The BPR is set to 3.0 bar, which is adequate for the chemical vapor pressure of DMF at 50°C, but it is woefully inadequate for the calculated fluidic resistance. The material choice (PFA) is chemically compatible, but the physical design is unsafe. Both candidates are BLOCKED due to the impossibility of the pressure drop values relative to the hardware limits.
